title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 1, QA) - Quant - Remainders
subject: Quant

questions.q: When $10^{100}$ is divided by 7, the remainder is
questions.explain: We need to find $10^{100} \pmod 7$. Since $10 \equiv 3 \pmod 7$, this is equivalent to finding $3^{100} \pmod 7$. By Fermat's Little Theorem, $3^6 \equiv 1 \pmod 7$. We write $100$ as $100 = 6 \times 16 + 4$. So, $3^{100} = (3^6)^{16} \times 3^4 \equiv 1^{16} \times 3^4 \equiv 81 \pmod 7$. Since $81 = 11 \times 7 + 4$, the remainder is 4.
